sonnet.problem: The card says a storm has been shoving the ship around. That is a fact from outside Acts 27:27-44 (the storm is told earlier in Acts 27) and it has no reference in the card's text. Only the prisoner and Italy facts are cited.
sonnet.rule: A fact from outside it gives its reference in brackets in the card's text, like "Jeremiah, a prophet (Jeremiah 1:5)."

sonnet.problem: The question says "Instead of anchors," which rules out the wrong answer "A sea anchor," since that is a kind of anchor. Story card 7 also says they only pretend to lower anchors.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: This True statement mostly repeats card 8, whose answer was that the sailors are letting down the lifeboat. It adds only "trying to escape," which is the same beat of verse 30 that cards 7 and 8 already covered.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
